question: The wet temperate type of forests are found between a height of _________ metres.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1000 and 2000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **wet temperate type of forests are typically found at higher elevations.**
 
• The correct range for the height of wet temperate forests is between** 1000 and 2000 meters.**
 
• Wet temperate forests are characterized by high levels of precipitation and moderate temperatures.
 
• **These forests are typically located in regions with cool, humid climates.**
 
• They are known for their diverse plant and animal species and dense vegetation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wet temperate forests:**

 
 
• These are a type of **forest ecosystem that exists in regions with temperate climates and high levels of rainfall.**
 
• They are particularly common in **mountainous areas, where the elevation provides the cool temperatures that these forests require.**
 
• Wet temperate forests are known for their** high biodiversity, including numerous species of trees, undergrowth plants, and animals.**
 
• In addition to the general characteristics o**f wet and cool climate, these forests often have unique features depending on their specific location and local conditions.**
